bundles.name: Apache
bundles.description: Commands to relaunch Apache, edit the httpd.conf file etc.

bundles.name: Bundle Development
bundles.description: This bundle has functionality related to developing bundles for TextMate.

bundles.name: Bundle Support
bundles.description: Do not uninstall: Support files for other bundles.

bundles.name: C
bundles.description: Support for the venerable C programming language and for the leaner C++. The bundle has completion (using ⌥⎋) for the standard C functions and, in C++, STL algorithms.

bundles.name: CSS
bundles.description: The cascading stylesheet language is used in web pages. This bundle has syntax highlight, lots of snippets, validation, and more.

bundles.name: Diff
bundles.description: Syntax highlight and diff related functionality, for example see differences between document and last saved version, use a diff file as a patch, etc.

bundles.name: Git
bundles.description: Support for the Git version control system.

bundles.name: HTML
bundles.description: Hypertext Markup Language support.

bundles.name: Hyperlink Helper
bundles.description: The commands in this bundle makes it easy to create hyper links for example by searching for the current word or using the clipboard contents. This bundle is much more useful than it sounds!

bundles.name: JSON
bundles.description: Syntax highlight for JavaScript Object Notation files, often used as a lightweight serialization format.

bundles.name: JavaScript
bundles.description: Support for JavaScript.

bundles.name: Mail
bundles.description: Support for writing email messages.

bundles.name: Make
bundles.description: Minimal syntax highlight and a build (make) command.

bundles.name: Markdown
bundles.description: Markdown allows you to write using an easy-to-read, easy-to-write plain text format, then convert it to structurally valid XHTML. This bundle provides preview functionality, syntax highlighting, and several useful commands.

bundles.name: Math
bundles.description: Support for performing different calculations inside TextMate.

bundles.name: Mercurial
bundles.description: Mercurial is a source Control Management system designed for efficient handling of very large distributed projects.

bundles.name: Objective-C
bundles.description: The language used for writing Cocoa applications. This bundle supports documentation lookups, method completion, and more.

bundles.name: PHP
bundles.description: PHP is a widely-used general-purpose scripting language that is especially suited for web development and can be embedded into HTML.

bundles.name: Property List
bundles.description: Support for the various forms of Apple’s Property List format (originally from NeXT).

bundles.name: Python
bundles.description: Support for the Python programming language.

bundles.name: Ruby
bundles.description: Support for the Ruby programming language.

bundles.name: SCM
bundles.description: Provides support for the various SCM (source control management) bundles.

bundles.name: SCM Diff Gutter
bundles.description: Show indication in gutter for added/modified lines

bundles.name: SQL
bundles.description: Database query language with support for MySQL and PostgreSQL.

bundles.name: Shell Script
bundles.description: Support for running and editing shell scripts (using the bash dialect).

bundles.name: Source
bundles.description: Miscellaneous support for working with source code. This bundle is essential, e.g. it allows you to toggle comments on ⌘/.

bundles.name: Subversion
bundles.description: Provides a nice interface to a multitude of Subversion commands.

bundles.name: Swift
bundles.description: Swift is a general-purpose programming language developed by Apple and built for safety, clarity, and performance.

bundles.name: TODO
bundles.description: If you tag your comments with <tt>TODO</tt>, <tt>FIXME</tt>, or similar, this bundle provides functionality to list all your tagged items, with the ability to jump to either of them.

bundles.name: Text
bundles.description: The text bundle has a lot of support for plain text and is a requisite for working with text.

bundles.name: TextMate
bundles.description: This bundle has functionality which add to the application but is not related to a specific task (bundle).

bundles.name: Themes
bundles.description: Themes for syntax highlight and (HTML) output.

bundles.name: XML
bundles.description: Support for the eXtensible Markup Language.
